findings.title: Ingress firewall rule opens SSH (22) or RDP (3389) from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.remediation: Restrict source_ranges to known bastion/VPN CIDR ranges, or remove the rule and use Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) TCP forwarding with a firewall rule scoped to 35.235.240.0/20 instead.

findings.title: Primitive role (roles/owner, roles/editor) granted at project scope
findings.remediation: Replace with the narrowest predefined role(s) that cover the principal's actual needs (see references/iam_least_privilege_guidelines.md), or a custom role scoped to the exact permission set.

manual_review_required.title: Project-level Cloud Audit Logging or an aggregated log sink is not configured
manual_review_required.rationale: Without Data Access audit logs and a durable, access-controlled log sink, there is no tamper-resistant record of who accessed what, which is usually the deciding evidence in an incident review.
manual_review_required.remediation: Configure google_project_iam_audit_config for the services in scope, and a google_logging_project_sink routing logs to a dedicated, access-restricted project or bucket. This requires organization-level context this scanner cannot fully verify from one module's plan -- confirm manually.

manual_review_required.title: Org policy constraints for public access prevention / external IPs / SA keys are not enforced
manual_review_required.rationale: Resource-level fixes (e.g. public_access_prevention on one bucket) can be silently undone by the next commit unless an org policy constraint makes the secure state the default for every future resource.
manual_review_required.remediation: Enforce constraints/storage.publicAccessPrevention, constraints/compute.vmExternalIpAccess, and constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation at the folder or org level. Verify manually -- these constraints usually live outside the module being scanned.
